sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by FACS staining for HA epitope under non-permeabilized conditions; no functional assay reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states the HA tag was inserted 'immediately after the signal peptide' of CADM4/Necl-4 in a full-length, membrane-anchored construct. The signal peptide spans residues 1–20 (authoritative landmark), placing the junction at insert_after_residue=20; Python confirms residue 20 = G and residue 21 = P. L2 (same paper) confirms surface display by FACS, and L3/L4 (PMC6371057) independently corroborate the same N-terminal extracellular junction with a Myc tag on a surface-displayed Cadm4 construct, providing cross-paper validation. The tag site is 303 residues from the TM boundary, well clear of any steric constraint. Full-length Necl-4/CADM4 expressed in CHO cells with an HA epitope tag inserted immediately after the signal peptide (residues 1–20) as predicted by SignalP; non-permeabilized FACS staining confirmed surface display of the HA epitope.

sources.claim: To facilitate analysis, the sequence encoding the influenza HA epitope was added by PCR to the N terminus of each Necl protein immediately after the signal peptide as predicted by the SignalP program.

literature_notes: L3/L4 (PMC6371057) describe a Myc-tagged Cadm4dCT construct used for surface detection in oligodendrocytes. CADM4 is a type I single-pass TM protein with only one extracellular terminus (N-terminal, after SP cleavage); topology derivation places the Myc tag at the same insert_after_residue=20 junction as L1/L2. Because both papers pin the identical junction and L1/L2 already provide a validated, residue-named site there, L3/L4 are treated as corroborating evidence for the single site rather than a separate entry. L5/L6 (PMC11427461) describe Cadm4-Flag and Cadm4-GFP constructs; the 'Cadm4-Flag' notation indicates a C-terminal fusion, and the C-terminus (residues 346–388) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks; these are recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for CADM4.

literature_other_positions.note: Cadm4-Flag and Cadm4-GFP are C-terminal fusions; the C-terminus (residue 388) lies in the intracellular domain (346–388) and is not accessible on the extracellular face.
C347 is the palmitoylation site critical for plasma membrane localization; it resides in the intracellular domain (346–388) and is not a surface-tag candidate.
